end.parentNote: Ananya practised identifying physical and chemical changes through examples and used evidence such as new substances, heat, light, smell, and colour change. They correctly classified several changes and explained that melting changes state without making a new substance. The main mix-up was that dissolved sugar seemed to disappear and lose mass; this was not corrected in the last response. At home, try dissolving a measured spoon of sugar in water, then taste the water and discuss how the sugar is still present even though it cannot be seen.

Define a chemical change (a new substance with new properties forms) and recognise its signs: gas, colour change, heat or light, new smell, new solid
Tell melting apart from dissolving and know that dissolved substances are still present
Classify everyday changes using evidence, knowing that 'can it be reversed?' is a clue but not the rule

turns.text: physical badlav hai, kyunki ghee pighle toh fir wapas jam sakta hai na, fridge mein rakh do toh, waise ghee ka photo bhi dikhao, mummy kal ghee se halwa bana rahi thi, but woh toh pura mix ho gaya, wapas nahi aaya, I'm confused ab.

Ghee ka pighalna physical badlav hai: sirf solid se liquid hua, naya padarth nahi bana. Halwa mein kai cheezein milkar pakti hain, isliye woh sirf ghee pighalne jaisa nahi hai; wapas jamna bas ek clue hai. Ghee ki tasveer ban rahi hai; tab tak sochiye, mombatti ka wax pighalna aur baati jalna kaise alag hain?

arrey maine toh pehle hi bol diya, wax pighalna physical hai, solid se liquid, wapas jam sakta hai, ghee ki tarah. baati jalna chemical, aag hai, light, heat, smell, sab kuch. par woh saboot wali baat... jaise naya padarth? wax pighle toh woh wax hi hai, baati jali toh raakh hai, woh wapas baati nahi ban sakti. waise, woh raakh ka photo dikhao na, aur wax pighla hua bhi. screen pe kuch nahi dikh r

Haan, aapne wax aur baati ka farq pehle hi bata diya tha. Screen par tasveer nahi dikh rahi, samajh gaya; jali baati ki raakh aur pighle wax ki tasveer ban rahi hai. Tab tak ek naya case: baarish ke baad iron railing par laal-bhoori parat ban gayi, jiske gun iron se alag hain. Yeh physical change hai ya chemical change?

chemical change hai, kyunki uski properties iron se different hai na, rust lagti hai woh, aur naya colour bhi hai. waise woh railing ka photo dikhao, rust wala, aur melting dissolving ka difference bhi batao, maine suna tha wo alag hai, board pe kya likha hai? screen pe woh saboot wali baat hai kya?

Bilkul, rust chemical change hai: iron par alag gunon wali nayi parat bani hai. Abhi board par wax ka solid se liquid hona aur baati se raakh, heat aur light likha hai; rust wali railing ki tasveer ban rahi hai. Melting mein baraf solid se liquid banti hai, jabki dissolving mein cheeni paani mein ghulkar bhi wahin rehti hai. Agar paani mein cheeni gholein, toh glass ka wazan badhega, utna hi rahega ya ghatega?

wazan... wait, cheeni toh gayab ho gayi na, dikhi nahi, toh wazan kam ho jana chahiye, right? magar teacher ne kaha cheeni wahin rehti hai... pata nahi, shayad utna hi rahe? par utna hi rahega toh dikhni chahiye na, magic jaisa hai! cheeni ka photo dikhao paani mein, mera favourite unicorn bhi dikhao, woh bhi magic karti hai!

Haan, cheeni dikhna band hoti hai, isliye wazan par doubt hona bilkul samajh aata hai. Cheeni paani mein ghulti hai, gayab nahi hoti; cheeni-paani ki tasveer ban rahi hai, aur unicorn ki asli photo nahi ho sakti kyunki woh kalpanik hai. Glass mein cheeni daalne ke baad, cheeni dikhe ya na dikhe, taraazu ka wazan pehle se zyada hoga, utna hi rahega, ya kam hoga?
ghatega, kyunki cheeni gayab ho gayi na, dikh nahi rahi, toh wazan bhi gayab!

Aap keh rahe hain cheeni dikhti nahi, toh uska wazan bhi gayab ho gaya. Sochiye, 100 gram paani mein 10 gram cheeni gholi: cheeni chhote hisson mein paani mein faili hai, nikli nahi, isliye glass ka wazan badhega. Ab namak paani mein hilaane par kya woh pighalta hai ya ghulta hai, aur dono mein kya farq hai?

pighalna alag hai melting, solid se liquid hota hai, jaise baraf pighli toh paani. namak paani mein dissolve hota hai, ghulta hai, dikhta nahi, lekin wahin rehta hai, jaise cheeni wala example tha. Kunal ko 'ghulna' bolna chahiye. lekin mujhe solid liquid wala yaad hai, pighalne mein naya padarth nahi, dissolving mein mixture hai na? pata nahi, confusing hai! melting ka photo dikhao, baraf ka, aur

Aapka confusion mixture ko lekar hai: ghulne par namak paani mein failta hai, naya padarth nahi banta. Pighalne mein baraf bina kuch milaye paani banti hai; ghulne mein namak paani ke saath mixture banata hai. Baraf ki tasveer ban rahi hai. Agar chocolate garam hokar liquid bane aur sugar room-temperature paani mein dikhe bina ghul jaaye, toh kis mein melting hui aur kis mein dissolving?

chocolate garam hokar liquid bana toh woh melting hai na, solid se liquid, simple. sugar wala dissolving hai, kyunki paani mein daal ke hilaya, gayab ho gayi. par sugar ab bhi maujood hai? pata nahi, dikh nahi rahi toh kya pata!

Cheeni dikhna band hoti hai, lekin paani mein faili rehti hai; 100 gram paani aur 10 gram cheeni milkar 110 gram ghol banate hain. Ab doodh bahar rakhne se khatta hokar phat jaaye, toh yeh physical badlav hai ya chemical, aur aapka saboot kya hai?

chemical change hai na, kyunki doodh phat gaya toh wapas doodh nahi ban sakta, smell bhi khatti aati hai, aur naya padarth ban gaya paneer jaisa kuch, maine kal hi dekha mummy ne phek diya khatta doodh, lekin wait, curd bhi toh doodh se banta hai, par curd wapas doodh ban sakta hai? mummy ne kaha nahi, toh chemical hi hua, but doodh phatne ka photo dikhao, woh dahi jaisa dikhta hai na, waise melti

Aapne khatti smell aur doodh ka phatna notice kiya; sirf wapas na ban pana chemical badlav ka pakka saboot nahi hota. Phate doodh ki tasveer ban rahi hai; usmein dahi jaisi gaadhi ganthain ho sakti hain, par dahi aur phata doodh ek jaise nahi hain. Ab poster kaatna aur phuljhari jalna, dono ko pehle jaisa banana mushkil hai: inmein chemical badlav kaunsa hai, aur kyun?

sparkler jalna chemical change hai kyunki usme aag hai, light aati hai, smell bhi aati hai, naya padarth banta hai raakh. poster kaatna physical hoga bas shape change hogi, paper ka paper hi hai. reversibility se zyada zaroori saboot matlab naya substance? sparkler ki raakh dikhao na, poster kata hua bhi!

Bilkul, sparkler mein raakh jaisa naya padarth banta hai; poster kaatne par kaagaz hi rehta hai. Dono ki tasveer ban rahi hai. Ab mithai banate waqt ek physical aur ek chemical badlav kya ho sakta hai?

mithai banate waqt... haan, chini daal ke gholna, woh dissolving hai na, physical, kyunki chini ghulti hai dikh nahi rahi lekin wahin hai, mummy ne bataya. aur agar doodh garam ho raha hai bullet proof wali kadhaai mein toh woh melting jaisa hai, physical bhi. chemical... chemical... kuch jal raha hai? nahi, mithai mein jalana nahi hota. oh, doodh phatne wali, nahi woh toh doodh khatta hua tha, mi

Aapne cheeni ghulne ko physical badlav bataya: cheeni paani mein rehti hai. Garam doodh ko melting nahi kahenge, kyunki doodh pehle se liquid hai. Mithai pakte waqt jab rang aur khushboo badle, toh sochiye kya naya padarth bana hoga. Mithai banne mein ek chemical badlav kaunsa ho sakta hai?

mithai bante waqt doodh garam karte hain na, to chemical badlav ho sakta hai, jaise doodh mein se kuch naya smell aata hai, aur rang bhi thoda change hota hai, bilkul jaise mummy rasgulla banate waqt doodh fatne lagta hai... par nahi, mummy ne bataya woh paneer ban jaata hai na, rusgulle mein daalte hain... to paneer naya padarth hai, chemical! aur ek physical badlav? haan, ghee pighalna, solid gh

Aapne rasgulle ke liye doodh phatne aur ghee pighalne ki baat ki. Sirf doodh garam hona chemical badlav ka saboot nahi; doodh phatkar alag padarth bane, toh baat alag hai. Ab aluminium sheet dabaakar lunchbox ka dhakkan banayein, bina kuch milaye: yeh physical badlav hai ya chemical, aur kyun?

physical change hai, kyunki sirf shape badli na, aluminium ka aluminium hi hai, naya kuch nahi bana. lekin board pe 'ghee: thos → liquid' likha hai, yeh melting hai? haan, melting bhi physical hai. aluminium ka dhakkan dikhao, aur ek baar phir se sparkler ki raakh ka photo dikhao, mujhe dekhna hai naya substance kaise dikhta hai!

Aapne aluminium ki shape badalne aur naya padarth na banne ki baat ki. Haan, ghee ka thos se liquid hona melting hai, aur yeh physical badlav hai. Aluminium dhakkan aur jali phuljhari ki raakh ki tasveer ban rahi hai; tab tak sochiye, raakh banne mein aluminium dabne se alag kya hua?
